decision.summary: A multi-sample cross-axis shift begins at index 451: N drops sharply (e.g., 0.12→-1.27→-3.44) and E surges (0.29→2.10→1.58), followed by sustained elevated E (~1.3–2.9) and variable N over ~78 samples. The offset does not resolve with a clear opposing return within the allowed context [450,579]; the return is unobserved/ambiguous, so status is uncertain. U shows no coherent offset pattern—varies irregularly without sustained deviation.

intervals.observation: N drops sharply from ~0.12 (index 450) to ~-1.3 to -3.4 over indices 451–454, then fluctuates between ~-0.1 and -2.6 through index 528; E rises from ~0.29 to ~1.5–2.9 by index 454 and remains elevated (~1.3–2.9) through index 528. No clear opposing return in N or E within allowed context [450,579]; sustained offset persists beyond screened region end (544), with no reversal observed before 579.
